key: nvidia|principal product manager dsx os infrastructure developer tooling
title: Principal Product Manager, DSX OS Infrastructure Developer Tooling
hiring_location: US, CA, Santa Clara, US, WA, Seattle
jd_excerpt:
At NVIDIA, we are shaping the future by building the most advanced AI factory from the ground up. You will work with groundbreaking technology to accelerate researchers, developers, and AI infrastructure providers around the world. Join our team known for its dedication to collaboration and outstanding performance! 
 What you’ll be doing: 
 Take ownership of the Infrastructure Developer Tools product strategy, roadmap, and requirements for DSX/DGXC to enable the NCP, OEM, and ISV ecosystem to left-shift software development 
 Tracking emerging trends in the AI Infrastructure space and assessing technical differentiators and ecosystem impact of new releases. 
 Supporting product marketing in crafting software component-specific messaging and documentation, including blogs, whitepapers, case studies, and presentations, highlighting NVIDIA’s optimizations and software tools. 
 Collaborating closely with internal engineering, infrastructure, and developer experience teams to enable best-in-class support to enable the NVIDIA ecosystem grow 
 Facilitating feedback loops between our platform and model builders to continuously improve performance, usability, and compatibility. 
 Work with executives to launch new products and support keynotes. 
 What we need to see: 
 15+ years of significant work experience in product management or technical partner management. 
 BS or MS or equivalent experience in engineering, computer science, or another technical field. MBA is a plus. 
 Knowledge of cloud infrastructure, bare-metal, and networking. Lower level Hardware/Software knowledge is a plus 
 Deep understanding and empathy for developer workflow and data center provisioning lifecycle 
 Comfortable reviewing code used in presentations, demos, and articles. 
 Experience creating marketing and social media. 
 Excellent written and spoken communication skills, including Microsoft products and Markdown skills, with the ability to translate between partner requirements and internal priorities. 
 You love to thrive in a cross-functional organization by collaborating with peers across teams and functions. 
 Deep organizational skills, capable of balancing multiple projects at the same time. 
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 Product manager experience at a company training frontier AI models and building AI infrastructure where you were helping developers be successful 
 Hardworking and highly motivated, with measurable results (metrics, awards, key accomplishments) you can share. 
 A growing portfolio of blogs and social posts with links to your relevant work, including technical writing, social media presence, videos, and research papers. 
 Hands-on experience with demoing technical products at major developer events and with customers 
 With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most hard-working and dedicated people in the world working for us and, due to outstanding growth, our special engineering teams are growing fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a genuine passion for technology, we want to hear from you. 
 #LI-Hybrid 
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 232,500 USD – 442,000 USD. 
 You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . 
 Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 29, 2026. 
 This posting is for an existing vacancy.
